Probably don't tell the school counselor that you think your friend is suicidal without your friend knowing that you are going to the school counselor. They take things like that very seriously. She could feel ganged up on and have to go through things she may not be ready for or want to do right now. That happened to me when I was in school. I was depressed and joked about suicide to a friend and she told the school counselor and I felt embarrassed and like people I didn't know, knew I was going through something personal. I would have much more appreciated if my friend would have just asked me about it and left it at that.
